name: MIREX Chord Recognition Evaluation
description: An MIREX benchmark for evaluating chord recognition systems, typically assessing automatic transcription of harmonic progressions from music audio.
evaluation_method: Chord label accuracy and weighted chord symbol recall under MIREX chord evaluation conventions.
notes: Chord recognition performance depends on segmentation, labelling granularity, and handling of inversions and extensions. Standardized evaluation is important for comparability.
